extDesc.message: Precisely filter YouTube Mixes, Shorts, watched videos, titles and channels. GitHub update notifications.

keywordsHint.message: One phrase per line, case-insensitive. Plain text, not regular expressions.

channelsHint.message: One exact channel name, @handle or channel URL per line. Exceptions override every filter; unknown channels cannot match.

safeHint.message: Unknown metadata never triggers a filter. Age: English/Russian publication labels only; conservative month estimates. Duration bounds are inclusive.

manualUpdate.message: Checks every 6 hours. Updates are installed manually; a commit is not a released version. The first check establishes the commit baseline.

resetConfirm.message: Restore default filters? Language, appearance and update preferences will be preserved.

previewActive.message: Preview: everything is visible in this tab

openYouTube.message: Open a YouTube tab to see statistics

reloadYouTube.message: Open / reload YouTube to see statistics

saved.message: Settings saved · applied without reloading YouTube

invalidDuration.message: Maximum duration must not be less than minimum duration.

respectReducedMotionLabel.message: Respect reduced motion in the OS

animationHint.message: Animation is off by default. Only visible cards dissolve into particles; other cards hide immediately. Disabling a filter or showing hidden cards cancels the effect immediately.

motionHint.message: The effect is skipped when the OS requests reduced motion. Turn this setting off to allow the effect regardless of the OS preference.

appearanceHint.message: Language changes immediately and also applies to notifications. Text size affects this settings window. All filters and the master switch remain on the Filters tab.

iconHint.message: The interface uses SVG. Chrome requires PNG copies for the extension toolbar and desktop notifications.

networkError.message: Cannot reach GitHub. Check your connection.

timeoutError.message: GitHub did not respond in time.

operationError.message: The operation failed. Please try again.
